integrity: All proofs, local inequalities and counting identities are self-contained. Standalone exact-rational enumeration checks 393120 configurations; no finite check is substituted for an infinite proof. Distinct prior settings and remaining bibliographic uncertainty are identified.
scientific_limitations: Only labeled two-action undirected wheels with uniform unit rim weights and positive uniform spokes; mixed equilibria and alternative payoffs not covered. Indifference is counted as weak Nash stability at the sharp boundary. Completeness and exactness are analytical; independent external validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp spoke-weight threshold for equilibrium entropy and welfare in wheel anti-coordination games
